_comment: Surface entrances to underground layers (DESIGN 3.1/3.3). Only layers with one clear surface entrance inside the surface crop are listed. Coordinates are OSRS Wiki map pins (sources below). Realms (abyss, fisher_realm, enchanted_valley, cosmic_plane, gorak_plane, yubiusk) get no portal by design.

portals.label: Zanaris
portals.description: Enter the Lumbridge Swamp shed while wielding a Dramen or Lunar staff (or with the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary).

portals.label: Mor Ul Rek
portals.description: Climb down the rocks at the top of the Karamja volcano, then take the cave entrance to Mor Ul Rek.
portals.source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mor_Ul_Rek (map 'The entrance to the volcano' x=2856 y=3168); https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Karamja_Volcano

portals.label: Myreque Hideout
portals.description: Wooden doors behind the hollow tree in the Hollows (the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub also leads in); needs In Search of the Myreque.
portals.source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Hollows (map pin 'Entrance from the Hollows' x=3509 y=3448); https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Myreque_Hideout

omitted.grimstone: The Grimstone Dungeon cave entrance is at (2912,4066) on Grimstone island (wiki Grimstone_Dungeon), north of the surface crop's y < 4032 limit, so it has no portal.
omitted.dorgesh_south: No single surface entrance: reached through Dorgesh-Kaan (from the Lumbridge Castle cellar / Lumbridge Swamp Caves) or by the tunnel from the Kalphite Lair.
omitted.abyss: Realm; reached via the Mage of Zamorak in the Wilderness, not a fixed entrance.
omitted.fisher_realm: Realm (magic whistle under the Brimhaven watchtower during Holy Grail).
